content: WXT background entrypoint: entrypoints/background.ts or entrypoints/background/index.ts, both compile to background.js. Uses defineBackground({ persistent, type: 'module', main() {...} }) or defineBackground(() => {...}). main() cannot be async and no runtime code may exist outside main() since WXT imports this file in Node during build. type:'module' is required to use ES import syntax (e.g. importing pv-wasm's generated JS glue) inside the service worker.
